# Christopher Heskett

Selected work includes Garden Party Pinball, VividGrasp, Smart Planter, and Subpix.

## Main Projects

- Garden Party Pinball (In progress): A full-size homebrew pinball machine using FAST boards, Mission Pinball Framework, coils, switches, lamps, cabinet wiring, and a revised playfield. Role: I am building the cabinet, playfield systems, wiring, MPF configuration, and test setup. Published media: 2.
- VividGrasp AI-Vision Robotics Arm (Completed team project): A Stanford AI4ALL team project connecting SolidWorks CAD, STL export, URDF/PyBullet simulation, target input, and robotic-arm motion. Role: Head CAD designer; prepared URDF files and worked with a teammate on a physical prototype. ([source](https://github.com/LenekyRadish/VividGrasp)). Published media: 4.
- Smart Self-Watering Pot / Smart Planter PCB (Prototype in progress): A plant-watering prototype involving moisture sensing, pump control, electronics packaging, enclosure planning, and PCB work. Role: I worked on the sensing and control concept, electronics packaging, PCB direction, and enclosure constraints. Published media: 3; interactive 3D models: 1.
- Subpix (Functional v1): An open-source Electron, Vite, React, and TypeScript desktop app for editing .subpix files, validating JSON data, exporting PNGs, and packaging for Windows. Role: Built the editor, file-format flow, export path, product site, and Windows packaging. ([Open app](https://subpix-editor.vercel.app/), [source](https://github.com/Chrissyuh/Subpix)). Published media: 1.

## More Projects

- Check-ins: Logs check-ins and shows gaps, streaks, and progress. ([project](https://check-ins-zeta.vercel.app/)). Published media: 0.

## Programs And Credentials

- Teen Engineering + Tech Center: Four-year after-school STEM program with engineering projects, makerspace work, tours, and college and career preparation. (Organization: ExxonMobil Foundation; [Program site](https://tetc.org/))
- Stanford AI4ALL Certificate of Completion: Completed Stanford AI4ALL in Robotics while working on the 10-person VividGrasp robotics project. (Issuer: Stanford AI4ALL and Stanford Pre-Collegiate Studies; Date: June 26, 2026; Certificate scan: available; [Program site](https://ai4all.spcs.stanford.edu/))

## Small Builds

- MIDI Practice Tool: Small Python tool for soundfonts, pedals, controls, and keyboard practice. Published media: 0.
- Desmos 3D Solar System: 3D orbit scene built in Desmos to practice surfaces and performance limits. ([project](https://www.desmos.com/3d/qcjp33t4ij)). Published media: 0.
- TinyGPT Experiments: Small next-token model experiments for learning training vs. instruction behavior. Published media: 0.
- VEX V5 Drivetrain Prototype: Quick drivetrain prototype for gearing, shaft spacing, and packaging. Published media: 0.
